content.text: Skip to main content What you need to know about NCAA March Madness® TNT Sports and CBS Sports will provide live coverage of the 2026 Division I Men's Basketball Championship. Watch 67 games on tbs, CBS, TNT and truTV and via NCAA March Madness Live. Here’s a play-by-play of everything you need to join the madness. National Championship: Michigan 69, UConn 63 Key Dates Selection Sunday® March 15 First Four® March 17-18 First Round March 19-20 Second Round March 21-22 Sweet 16® March 26-27 Elite Eight® March 28-29 Final Four® April 4 Championship Game April 6 Watch The Games In More Places From the First Four to the National Championship game, tbs, TNT and truTV let you take the action with you wherever you are.
